title: Running in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin is one of Europe's easiest running cities**: it is almost completely flat, its parks are enormous, and a good loop starts within fifteen minutes of most hotels. Loop details checked on 2 September 2026.

**The six loops that cover almost every visitor**: the Tiergarten classic (about 5 km from the Brandenburg Gate), the Museum Island sunrise round (about 3 km), the Tempelhofer Feld ring (about 5 km on airport taxiways), the Landwehrkanal towpath (about 6.5 km there and back), Treptower Park and the Spree (about 3 km), and the Volkspark Friedrichshain round (about 3 km with the city's best hill).
**Run early.** Before 09:00 every loop works, the Museum Island round is empty, and September air is at its coolest. From late morning the historic centre is a crowd, not a course.
**After dark, choose lit streets over park paths.** Tiergarten side paths are unlit, the canal goes dim between bridges, and **Tempelhofer Feld locks its gates at 20:30 in September**.

**Marathon week matters**: the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON runs on Sunday 27 September 2026, with the GENERALI 5K on the Saturday. Expect central road closures that weekend, and expect every flat route to feel like a shared celebration.
**Carry water on the field, not on the canal.** Tempelhofer Feld has no taps on the open field; the Landwehrkanal and Tiergarten routes pass kiosks and cafes most of the way.
